brief: Return to canonical Roki and current Hermes UI; four restrained variations with matching Bots and Chat views. No new character families or major layout/typography changes.

directions.name: Clear White
directions.summary: Neutral white, orange actions, light glass borders
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise style-transfer of the actual product.
The owner strongly rejected invented identities, animals, plants, typographic mascots and large layout changes. Now they want ROKY / ROKI and an interface CLOSE TO THE CURRENT HERMES STUDIO UI. This is a restrained evolution of their real screenshots.
INPUTS: Image 1 = actual Bots screen, EDIT TARGET and exact structure reference. Image 2 = actual Echo chat, EDIT TARGET and exact structure reference. Image 3 = canonical compact Roki portrait, IDENTITY REFERENCE. Image 4 = canonical full-body Roki, IDENTITY REFERENCE. Preserve this exact character, not a replacement.
OUTPUT COMPOSITION: one TALL PORTRAIT 2:3 comparison sheet, approximately 1024 x 1536, with two LARGE WIDE screenshots stacked vertically. Top = Bots; bottom = Echo chat. Each screen keeps its original roughly 1.46:1 aspect ratio, never squeeze or stretch the UI. Narrow white gutter, small concept label at top. No oversized marketing title, separate character poster, avatar-family strip, perspective, decorative scene or laptop frame. Both screens should look like credible edited screenshots of this very app.
STRICT LAYOUT PRESERVATION: keep the current left sidebar, search, Dashboard/Bots/Team rooms/Routines/Settings, the TEAM list with Atlas/Nova/Scout/Echo and their roles, current Bots card grid and card hierarchy, filter pills, New bot button, Chat buttons and menu controls. Preserve the same card proportions and spacing; the source has three columns with the next row partially visible. Do not turn this into a different dashboard or a new 2x2 template. In chat keep the existing left sidebar, central Echo header and welcome area, bottom composer, and right teammate inspector in the same proportions. Keep the current compact sans-serif type and existing font sizes, only refine weight/contrast. Keep all visible names, roles, text and controls, do not rename bots to Roki. The native engine strip can stay but make its styling coherent, with the real This Mac/Home server labels.
ROKI IDENTITY: the exact GRAPHITE FACETED ROCK character, recognizable polygon silhouette, dark recessed face, two warm upright rounded eye marks, orange side insert, original light sneakers with black straps and orange soles ONLY on the full-body mascot. Interface avatars MUST be compact HEAD PORTRAITS as in Image 3; no sneakers or full-body sticker in every small tile. Use the full character ONLY once in the chat welcome, at the same restrained size as the screenshot. No recoloring into white/blue/orange bodies, no different species, no limbs added, no redesign of the silhouette, no new mouth, teeth or outfits. Soften light, slightly lighten the face recess, keep relaxed vertical eyes or gentle happy eye arcs; never inward angled hostile eyes. Preserve the character's orange insert and all saved bot names.
STYLE: apply ONLY the individual palette/material brief below. Bright readable neutral-white reading surfaces, restrained glass and controlled luminous gradient where stated. No beige, cream, sepia or purple/lavender backgrounds. No fantasy illustration, plants, animals or giant sculptural lettering. Main point: the real Hermes interface with Roki, polished and subtly varied.
OPTION 01 / CLEAR WHITE.
Most conservative refinement. Neutral pure-white canvas and sidebar; white bot cards with a fine cool-grey edge, mild existing round corners and very light shadows. Graphite-black headings, clear medium-grey body text. Saturated orange #FF7A20 primary actions and orange-to-tangerine gradient ONLY within New bot/send controls; a small light orange active-navigation accent. Existing secondary pills remain white, no dark heavy neumorphism. Keep the current native-like sans type, no display font experiment. Roki stays matte graphite with soft even frontal light, relaxed open vertical warm eyes and the existing orange accent. Portrait framing is a simple clear neutral rounded tile. This should feel like the current app cleaned up in bright daylight, not a redesign.

Small portrait tiles are clear, light and neutral. Keep font family and hierarchy current, slightly more confident weights. Familiar product with more coherent graphite-and-orange identity.
